title: Bhalobasa Bhalobasa
desc: Sidhu meets and falls in love with a woman named Priya despite being engaged to a different girl. He soon has to make a choice between following his heart and respecting his father's wishes.

title: Rupban
desc: A 12-year-old Rupban is married to Rahim when he is just 12 days old. However, their lives take a turn when Rahim grows older, only to refuse to accept Rupban as his wife and fall in love with Tajel.

title: Suorani Duorani
desc: The king of Kishangarh marries a girl, unaware that she is a demoness. Upon learning the truth about his stepmother, the prince decides to save his father and their kingdom from her evil plans.

title: Sundar Bou
desc: Sabitri, who is married to Nanda, is exploited daily by her mother-in-law. Seeing this, her uncle decides to help her overcome her problems.

title: Debibaran
desc: Satyapriyo fights for justice when his sister is raped. During his fight, he takes on a corrupt village official in a twisted turn of events.
